items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: Me, Sylvester, and the drummer. Just us three we played again when I was playing my banjo and anything.

ctx.x: Just with a banjo and guitar and violin or something like that?

No, we had five pieces, but a lot of the boys didn't come. Yeah. So me and the bass player, I think the boys played in the big high range a whole lot. That's John's brother. Oh, you mean Sylvester? Sylvester Hand. Me, Sylvester, and the drummer. Just us three we played again when I was playing my banjo and anything. And we made more money that night we played together, you know, than when the band was in. And somebody come in one night and we had a bad trip and still alive. Mm-hm.
Sam Morgan You're saying Sam Morgan? Come on, now.
